title: The Gas Pump Speed Trap Stealing Your Money

vo.en: Stop pumping gas at full speed.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's hand firmly gripping a gas pump handle at a station.

vo.en: Blasting fuel at max pressure creates a chaotic splash zone inside your tank.

visual.description: High-speed footage of liquid splashing violently inside a dark container.

vo.en: This turbulence turns liquid gas into a frothy foam, much like a poured soda.

visual.description: Close-up of bubbles and foam rising rapidly in a glass vessel.

vo.en: But here is the secret that costs you money.

visual.description: A man looking frustrated while looking at a wallet with only a few bills left.

vo.en: That foam triggers the nozzle’s auto-stop sensor long before the tank is actually full.

visual.description: Close-up of the gas pump nozzle clicking upward automatically to stop the flow.

vo.en: You leave with air pockets instead of fuel, making your mileage look terrible.

visual.description: Close-up of a car fuel gauge needle dropping toward the empty red line.

vo.en: Use the lowest click for a dense, steady flow that fills every inch.

visual.description: Extreme close-up of a man's finger setting the small metal latch on the pump handle to the first notch.

vo.en: Subscribe for more hidden hacks and comment your mileage difference after trying this, which is exactly why you...
